changes: MIDI Loopback 1.6 (tag v1.6, 02c1638), imported unchanged: loopback.s and cclabels.s. It routes MIDI on internal channels back into the Digitakt's MIDI input and names the Digitakt's parameters on the MIDI tracks' CC Select page; SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK switches it.

build.json is the author's mod.json: its sites became address, length and SHA-256 guards, and its keep2 sites (pea) guarded bytes with a relocation; the 1.54 release takes its own defsym and sites. The catalog record adds needs_core 4.1, as the README requires.
transformations: None to the author's files. Stock bytes in mod.json's sites became SHA-256 guards in build.json, and its keep2 sites guarded bytes with a relocation (pea).
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata.
